description: Code on Social Security 2020 s.2(88) second proviso: where the payments EXCLUDED from wages (here HRA and conveyance allowance) exceed one-half of ALL REMUNERATION, the excess is DEEMED to be wages. Hand derivation: BASIC 9000.0000 + DA 3000.0000 = included 12000.0000; HRA 12000.0000 + CONVEYANCE_ALLOWANCE 6000.0000 = excluded 18000.0000; total remuneration 30000.0000; the threshold is 50% so the floor is 15000.0000; excluded 18000.0000 exceeds it, so the add-back is 18000.0000 - 15000.0000 = 3000.0000 and the statutory wage is 12000.0000 + 3000.0000 = 15000.0000, exactly one-half of the total. Without the proviso the PF and ESI base would be 12000.0000 and every contribution downstream would be understated by 20%. This leaf is UPSTREAM of both PF and ESI, so an error here is systematic rather than isolated.
